issue_snapshot.title: Follow-ups from #35: 17 from the review, 1 from QA
issue_snapshot.body:
What the review and QA of PR #46 (for #35) found and did not fix there — filed as it merged, one ticket for the lot.

## From the review

Non-blocking findings the reviewer approved despite: a statement about severity, not a judgement that they are wrong.

### A repeated ?section= query key crashes the group page instead of defaulting to expenses.

> A repeated ?section= query key crashes the group page instead of defaulting to expenses.
> 
> `lib/groups/validation.ts:165`
> 
> Evidence: lib/groups/validation.ts:165 does (raw ?? '').trim().toLowerCase(). Next.js delivers searchParams values as string | string[], so ?section=expenses&section=balances hands groupSectionFrom a string[], on which .trim() throws TypeError. GroupPage parses section at app/groups/[id]/page.tsx:119 before the ledger try/catch, so the throw escapes to the route error boundary rather than rendering the expenses panel that AC-2/AC-10 require for malformed input.
> 
> Fix: Coerce before trimming, e.g. const value = (Array.isArray(raw) ? raw[0] : raw ?? '').trim().toLowerCase(). Note activityFilterFrom and expenseFiltersFrom share the pattern; fixing only the new parser leaves the same crash on ?activity= and ?q=.

### The diff edits a file the work order does not name: lib/activity/queries.ts gains ACTIVITY_GROUP_PARAM, but work-order.json files[] lists only nine paths and this is not one of them.

> The diff edits a file the work order does not name: lib/activity/queries.ts gains ACTIVITY_GROUP_PARAM, but work-order.json files[] lists only nine paths and this is not one of them.
> 
> `lib/activity/queries.ts:56`
> 
> Evidence: work-order.json files[] names app/groups/[id]/page.tsx, app/groups/[id]/loading.tsx, app/groups/[id]/expenses/loading.tsx, components/group-page.tsx, components/timestamp.tsx, components/activity-feed.tsx, app/activity/page.tsx, lib/groups/validation.ts and lib/dates.ts (the four *.test.ts paths live under tests[], not files[]); gh pr diff 46 --name-only adds lib/activity/queries.ts, whose PR-branch line 56 is the new `export const ACTIVITY_GROUP_PARAM = 'group';` inside hunk @@ -41,6 +41,20 @@ with a comment block and no read, signature or endpoint change.
> 
> Fix: Name lib/activity/queries.ts in files[] as the supporting edit for the authorized app/activity/page.tsx ?group= scope (the constant sits beside ACTIVITY_FILTER_PARAM so the writer and reader cannot drift), or keep it and record the exception; no behavior change is needed.

### Failed-state filter chips on a scoped /activity feed drop the ?group= scope

> Failed-state filter chips on a scoped /activity feed drop the ?group= scope
> 
> `app/activity/page.tsx:127`
> 
> Evidence: app/activity/page.tsx:127 renders <FilterChips filter={filter} action="/activity" /> with no preserved prop, while the success branch at :154 passes preserved={{ [ACTIVITY_GROUP_PARAM]: scoped.id }}. FilterChips (components/activity-feed.tsx:142-156) submits only its own form plus hidden inputs from preserved, so clicking any chip on a failed scoped feed navigates to unscoped /activity. The retry link on the same screen does preserve the scope.
> 
> Fix: Pass the same preserved value to the failed-branch FilterChips: preserved={scoped === null ? {} : { [ACTIVITY_GROUP_PARAM]: scoped.id }}.

### Members-excerpt placeholder badge wording contradicts its own comment and the members page

> Members-excerpt placeholder badge wording contradicts its own comment and the members page
> 
> `app/groups/[id]/page.tsx:935`
> 
> Evidence: app/groups/[id]/page.tsx:935 renders label 'Hasn't joined yet' under comment 'in the words the members page already uses', but the members page (components/groups-panels.tsx:616) renders <Badge>Placeholder</Badge>. Same seat, two names across one navigation.
> 
> Fix: Use label 'Placeholder' to match the members page, or correct the comment if the new wording is deliberate.

### lib/activity/queries.ts is edited by the PR but listed in neither the work order's files[] nor its tests[]: the ACTIVITY_GROUP_PARAM const lives there.

> lib/activity/queries.ts is edited by the PR but listed in neither the work order's files[] nor its tests[]: the ACTIVITY_GROUP_PARAM const lives there.
> 
> `lib/activity/queries.ts:56`
> 
> Evidence: gh pr diff 46 --name-only lists 14 files including lib/activity/queries.ts; work-order.json files[] names 9 paths without it and tests[] names only the four *.test.ts paths. The hunk is const-only (+14 lines: ACTIVITY_GROUP_PARAM = 'group' beside ACTIVITY_FILTER_PARAM, no read, signature or schema change). Required by the feature and correctly placed per the GROUP_SECTION_PARAM convention, so de minimis — but unlisted is unlisted.
> 
> Fix: Amend the work order's files[] to include lib/activity/queries.ts (const-only addition). Do not move the const: beside ACTIVITY_FILTER_PARAM is where the key convention says it lives, since the group page link writer and the /activity reader must share one spelling.

### Summary-card transfer lines name departed members without the 'No longer in the group' label AC-12 requires wherever a departed seat renders.

> Summary-card transfer lines name departed members without the 'No longer in the group' label AC-12 requires wherever a departed seat renders.
> 
> `app/groups/[id]/page.tsx:401`
> 
> Evidence: app/groups/[id]/page.tsx:401-409 renders transfers.slice(0, TRANSFER_LINES) via transferWords with no departed check, while transfers = simplifyDebts(ledger.balances) where balances still contains departed seats with non-zero nets (cf. the `shown` filter at :259-262 which exists precisely because balances includes them). The Balances tab rows do label them (:642-644). So a transfer involving a departed seat prints e.g. 'Bo owes you' in the summary with no badge, one screen above rows that carry it.
> 
> Fix: Apply the same currentIds check in the summary transfer lines (badge or parenthetical) or look up transfer endpoints against members the way the balance list does.

### GroupPage doc comment promises scriptless readers 'get all four' panels, contradicting the AC-16 contract this same PR establishes (skeleton plus JS-required notice, no ledger).

> GroupPage doc comment promises scriptless readers 'get all four' panels, contradicting the AC-16 contract this same PR establishes (skeleton plus JS-required notice, no ledger).
> 
> `app/groups/[id]/page.tsx:75`
> 
> Evidence: app/groups/[id]/page.tsx:75: 'the panels are server-rendered, and a reader without JavaScript gets all four.' Under App Router streaming with the route-level loading.tsx boundary, the resolved ledger waits in the hidden Flight payload for the client-JS swap, so a scriptless reader keeps the skeleton plus the

alternatives_considered.approach: Converge formatExpenseDate and humanDateLabel into a single ladder
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: The shapes serve different readers on purpose: the editor preview pairs the relative word with the absolute day and names Tomorrow because the chooser's today is the viewer's local day, while ledger rows use the weekday ladder against server UTC; merging them would change shipped copy, so the plan shares the parser and documents the difference instead

alternatives_considered.approach: Restructure the members page guard below its loading boundary in the same change
alternatives_considered.rejected_because: No finding asks for it and it changes first-paint auth behavior on a second route; the members page keeps its route-level loading file and only gains the noscript notice

validated_work_order.approach: Fix each live finding at its root and drop the two that need no edit. Coerce repeated query keys once in a shared firstQueryValue helper used by all three filter parsers; preserve the ?group= scope in both branches of /activity and fall back to the raw param for the retry; rebuild /activity with the guard above an in-page Suspense and delete its loading.tsx; delete the orphaned UTC Timestamp cluster and its pinning tests; label departed transfer endpoints with the existing Badge; unify the placeholder badge on Placeholder; scope the disclosure rotation to the chevron and remove its checkbox from the desktop tab order; share one calendar-day validator between lib/dates.ts and lib/money/human-date.ts with documented ladders; reword the GroupPage doc comment to the AC-16 contract; and add the group's noscript JavaScript-required notice to the members and activity skeletons.
assumptions: Next.js delivers repeated query keys as string[], which is what makes the .trim() calls throw
A departed seat can hold a non-zero balance after its membership row is gone (e.g. a later expense delete shifts its net), so the summary badge has a reachable state
validated_work_order.confidence_rationale: Every finding was re-read against current main: exact vulnerable lines, both badge wordings, both disclosure defects, the orphaned exports and their only test importer, and the array-safety of the notice parsers were all confirmed directly.

validated_work_order.understanding: Issue #58 collects 18 follow-ups from PR #46 (issue #35): a repeated ?section=/?activity=/?q= query key crashes filter parsers that call .trim() on string|string[]; failed-state /activity filter chips and retry drop the ?group= scope; the members-excerpt placeholder badge says Hasn't joined yet while the members page says Placeholder; summary transfer lines omit the No longer in the group badge the Balances rows show; the GroupPage docblock promises scriptless readers all four panels contrary to the skeleton-plus-notice contract; the UTC-labelled Timestamp cluster in ui-interactive.tsx is production-dead with its output pinned only by ui-set.test.ts; the expense-filter disclosure rotates both icons and leaves its checkbox in the desktop tab order; /activity keeps the guard-below-boundary shape; calendar-day parsing and date ladders exist twice; and no-JS readers get a silent skeleton on members/activity. The ACTIVITY_GROUP_PARAM const placement findings need no edit (already correctly placed). No decisions were recorded in plan/brief.md and no prior plan was rejected.
